summary: Completed comprehensive testing of STT (Speech-to-Text) feature for DEMSTAV Operations PWA. Backend API fully functional with Emergent managed OpenAI Whisper (model whisper-1). Frontend dictation component working correctly with recording, transcription, offline handling, and auto-retry functionality. All core STT features tested and verified.
